::: {#exm-hers-reference-group}
#### The placebo group as the reference group in HERS

To compare the [risks](#def-outcome-risk) of regular exercise in @exm-hers-outcome-risk,
take the placebo group as the reference group
and the hormone therapy group as the group being compared with it.
Then a difference is hormone therapy minus placebo,
and a ratio is hormone therapy divided by placebo.
:::
